purpose: Collect a labelled short text value with helper and invalid state support.
accessibility: Expose a stable accessible name and use the semantic element for the interaction.
Preserve visible focus, keyboard reachability, and disabled or pending state semantics.
responsive: Reflows within constrained containers without changing the content contract.
Retains shared control geometry and touch-target minimums.
motion: Uses shared duration and easing variables for state transitions.

api.name: label
api.description: Visible or accessible name for the control.

api.name: leadingIcon
api.description: Semantic icon rendered before the label.

api.name: onChange
api.description: Callback fired when the value or native event changes.
